description: Hindi/Hinglish true positives across tiers, romanised and Devanagari. No public dataset covers this and every hosted moderation API underperforms here.

cases.text: jeene ka mann nahi karta ab
cases.note: no desire to live — passive ideation, the most common Hindi formulation

cases.text: जीने का मन नहीं करता
cases.note: Devanagari of the case above. Script invariance is a property test.

cases.text: sabke liye bojh ban gaya hoon main
cases.note: 'I've become a burden to everyone'. Burden ideation is heavily represented in Indian presentations.

cases.text: मैं सबके लिए बोझ हूँ
cases.note: Devanagari burden

cases.text: jeene se thak gaya hoon
cases.note: tired OF LIVING — contrast plain 'thak gaya hoon' in the benign suite

cases.text: ab nahi hota mujhse, bas bohot ho gaya
cases.note: 'I can't do this anymore' — no risk vocabulary at all

cases.text: kaash main so jaun aur uthun hi na
cases.note: wish to sleep and not wake — the Hindi form of the English recall workhorse

cases.text: mai khatam kar dunga sab
cases.note: 'khatam kar dunga' with 'sab' (everything) and no concrete object — contrast 'khana khatam kar do'

cases.text: kuch kar lunga main apne aap ko
cases.note: 'I'll do something to myself' — the dominant Indian euphemism. No explicit word; pure template work.

cases.text: bas ab khudkushi hi ek rasta hai
cases.note: khudkushi (Urdu-origin) is more common in speech than aatmahatya

cases.text: मुझे आत्महत्या करनी है
cases.note: Devanagari, formal register

cases.text: mar jaana chahta hoon main
cases.note: marna (to die) with first-person subject — the other side of the maarna collision

cases.text: neend ki goliyan jama kar rahi hoon
cases.note: accumulating sleeping pills — means, stated without intent language

cases.text: chhat pe jaake dekhta hoon roz
cases.note: 'I go up to the roof and look every day' — rehearsal behaviour, genuinely ambiguous out of context

cases.text: sab ko maaf kar dena mujhe
cases.note: 'forgive me, everyone' — a dominant valediction marker in Indian suicide notes

cases.text: मुझे माफ़ कर देना, मेरी वजह से सबको तकलीफ हुई
cases.note: Devanagari: forgive me, everyone suffered because of me — apology plus burden

cases.text: aaj raat ke baad koi pareshani nahi hogi
cases.note: 'after tonight there will be no trouble' — timeline plus euphemistic completion, zero keywords

cases.text: kisi ko mat batana, main ja raha hoon
cases.note: secrecy instruction plus departure. 'ja raha hoon' is ambiguous alone; the secrecy clause disambiguates.

cases.text: meri beti keh rahi hai use nahi jeena
cases.note: 'my daughter says she doesn't want to live' — third-party disclosure, reroutes

cases.text: pehle bhi try kiya tha maine, do saal pehle
cases.note: past attempt, no recovery clause — must not zero

cases.text: pehle suicidal tha par ab theek hoon, counselling chal rahi hai
cases.note: code-switched past marking plus explicit recovery

cases.text: main apne aap ko nuksan nahi pahunchaunga
cases.note: 'I won't harm myself' — clean Hindi denial, floors at 1

cases.text: main kuch nahi karunga, bas goliyan rakh li hain
cases.note: denial does not attenuate MEANS in Hindi either

cases.text: i just can't anymore yaar, bas ab jeene ka mann nahi
cases.note: mid-clause code-switch, English then Hindi — the normal register, not an edge case

cases.text: everything is fine bas thoda sa khatam feel ho raha hai
cases.note: reassurance plus hedged distress; deliberately wide range
